vibe_rationale: Curated monthly design, fashion, food and DJ weekend in a 19th-century Poblenou factory; strong local creative scene, slightly commercial.
fit_notes: An adult Poblenou creative crowd with a daytime dance floor and food, and beverage and food brands already partner, so a sampling or lounge spot fits naturally. The monthly format lets a brand test and repeat, and a local partner would be needed.
